$comment: docs/296 plan §6: scenario 1, the habit tracker, against the phase-2 demo instance (plan §9). `repo.commit` pins `main` of the demo app: the merge of PR #1, which added the demo-specific files (`.claude/settings.json` redirect — `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` only, no key — `x-shipit-preview: auto`, `agent.install: npm ci`) on top of the template scaffold — the driver refuses a take whose `git ls-remote HEAD` differs. `proxyUrl` is the proxy as seen from the driver host (the tailnet publish in `scripts/demo-video/host/demo-proxy.compose.yml`); the demo repo's settings file names the same proxy as `http://demo-proxy:8787`, its name on the instance's network. No `model` pin: the demo instance has one harness (Claude) and its default route is the one to record. `permissionMode: auto` is the only mode whose allowlisted tools never prompt; it is the composer's default and the driver verifies the control reads it after the claim, and aborts any wait on a pending permission prompt (the CLI's sensitive-file gate is outside every ShipIt mode). `pace.typingCharsPerSecond` is the driver's typing rate; `pace.textCharsPerSecond` is passed to the proxy as `--pace-chars-per-second` on replay. Kept time: Σ(lead + hold) = 36 s.

beats.type: Build a habit tracker with a light theme: a list of daily habits, a check button on each, and a streak counter that goes up when you check one. Seed three example habits with streaks of 4, 2 and 0.
Switch it to dark mode with a violet accent, and retitle the page 'Streaks'.
